name: Pan Electronics (India) Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1986, Pan Electronics India Ltd is a manufacturer of BOPP Films and Capacitors.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
PEIL is a TUV-CE, RoHS, REACH, SA8000:2014, and ISO certified manufacturer of a range of MFD Capacitors & Metallized Polypropylene Polyester Film products.

pros: Debtor days have improved from 222 to 139 days.
cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
